# Forum debates: Yoda vs Sidious, Mace vs Sidious, Yoda vs Mace (Suspect Insight)

Read 2026-10-12. Raw HTML + parsed text in `forum-raw/` (`t205*.html` → `t205.c.txt`, `t313*` → `t313.c.txt`, plus `t536`, `t3544`, `t3555`, `t1385`, `t3667`, `t2186`, `t3251`).
Every forum verdict below is **opinion only**. Primary-source quotes that posters actually typed out are kept with their named source. Image-only "quote scans" are marked *scan, not verified*.
SI default (per t205, citing the t9 versus guidelines): threads are Legends unless stated otherwise.

---

## 1. t205 "Yoda V Sidious (Rematch)": ROTS both, all out, neutral ground (78 posts, May–Sep 2019)
URL: https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t205-yoda-v-sidious-rematch (4 pages)

### Pro-Yoda / "at least a stalemate" case (ArkhamAsylum3 / NotAA3 [Guest], O-Siri/Kilius, xolthol)
- **The finish was environmental.** Their power "mutually overloaded and sent them both flying". Yoda fell because he's lighter and was standing at the pod's edge. Backed by the ROTS junior novel: "Palpatine was larger and heavier; he managed to catch hold of the edge of the pod as he fell. But Yoda was small and light."
- **Yoda had the upper hand in sabers on neutral ground (the office).** ROTS script: "Their swords CLASH... PALPATINE seeks refuge in the vast Senate Chamber." ROTS JN: "The thought gave Yoda renewed energy, and he pressed his attack. He drove Palpatine back across the room, into the Chancellor's podium."
- **The disarm.** ROTS JN: "Yoda redoubled the speed of his blows... the red lightsaber spun out of his hands and over the edge." Script: "It looks as if the Dark Lord is doomed."
- **Sidious was tired too.** ROTS novel (Stover): "the victorious shadow became once again only Palpatine: a very old, very tired man, gasping for air as he leaned on the pod's rail." [panel: panels/yoda/yoda-panel-2.png]
- **Why Yoda left.** ROTS JN: "There would be no second chance to kill the Emperor; he would summon his clone troops immediately for protection." ROTS novel: "sirens sounded throughout the enormous building... Clone troops were already swarming into it." [panel: panels/yoda/yoda-panel-2.png]
- **Secondary-source summaries are vague.** Most just say "too strong for Yoda to defeat"; some say "equal" (O-Siri: "Yoda is either no match or a direct match according to these secondary sources").
- **Bump quotes (Jake, Sep 2019):** "Palpatine called upon his dark arts, slashing away in fury, but Yoda's accomplished command of the Force blocked his every blow. Overmatched, Palpatine fled into the vast Senate Chamber." (*Star Wars Episode III: Movie Storybook*, scan). "The two opponents are among the most powerful Force-users in the galaxy, but the ascendant dark side has made Sidious stronger." (*Star Wars in 100 Scenes*, scan). Jake's read: Yoda > in sabers, and Sidious's edge is attributed to the rising darkness.
- ArkhamAsylum3 (Sep 2019) **retracted**: "dead equals in Force Power and Yoda as superior in sabers, though I don't think it's enough for him to win."

### Pro-Sidious case (Azronger, Greysentinel/HeartoftheForce, DarthSkywalker0, SithSauce, PeraltaEagle45, MasterCilghal)
- **Lightning neutralizes Yoda's saber edge** (Azronger): "Sidious can disarm him whenever he chooses to with lightning, and then it would become a pure Force battle." ROTS JN: "the dark side pulsed as he drew even more Force lightning... ready to throw back at the Sith Lord the moment his attack stopped. But Palpatine didn't stop". At range, only Yoda holds the build-up. ROTS JN: "Hurling Force lightning, the Emperor backed away... Never had Yoda faced one so strong in the dark side. Before he came within reach, a particularly strong blast knocked Yoda out of the pod."
- **Rebuttal to the range trap** (Rohirrim, pro-Sidious overall): lightning weakens with distance; in the film Yoda recovers and matches it once disarmed.
- **Yoda burned out first** (Grey): a scan says "Even the most powerful Jedi has his limits and the fight with Sidious exhausts Yoda" (*scan, source not named in the post*). Yoda was "bruised and battered", Palpatine "just out of breath". [panel: panels/yoda/yoda-if-you-want-say-yoda-edge-he-1.jpg]
- **ROTS novel quotes** (SithSauce, *image scans*, contents not typed out).
- **Lucas / ILM.** Azronger posted two "Lucas' two cents" *scans* (Insider "Yoda's Right Arm", not typed out). Grey (HeartoftheForce) typed: "Wheless' team worked out three key poses... 2) Yoda is forced back by Sidious' power, and grimaces in pain 3) Yoda uses all of his strength to push Sidious back... The shot is only three seconds long, but it communicates to the audience that Yoda has met his match" (*Star Wars Insider* #86). Also typed: Ultimate Star Wars (Canon, 2015) "Ultimately the battle proves too much for Yoda"; "Yoda is eventually outmatched by Sidious" (title cut off in the post). Azronger typed *The Comics Companion*: "Palpatine is too strong for the aging Yoda".
- **Self-feeding imbalance** (Azronger): the darkness strengthening Sidious is his own doing, so it counts as his power. ROTS JN: "With the strength of the dark side growing, the Sith must, logically, have grown stronger, too... This time, he wasn't sure." DarthAnt66 reads "ascendant dark side" as the Order 66 shift instead.
- Gideon/Tempest recalls a guide line "his spirit perhaps broken by the deaths of so many Jedi" (*source not given, from memory*).
- Pro-Sidious one-liners: dark-sith123, HeartoftheForce, Master Azronger ("Sidious wins. Again. Every time."), MasterCilghal ("close fight"), Latham2000, HellfireUnit ("a battle he lost before his birth").
- **Count (opinion):** clearly pro-Sidious ≈ 10 posters. Pro-Yoda or equal ≈ 4 (AA3 later retracted to "Sidious wins narrowly"; O-Siri, xolthol, Jake lean equal).

## 2. t536 "Yoda & Sidious duelling": sabers only, flat ground (25 posts, Aug 2019)
- The OP's point: the podium "disadvantage" was Sidious's own choice (Ziggy: "Most sources have Palpatine retreating to the pod").
- Quote typed: ROTS JN "Yoda redoubled the speed of his blows. Palpatine parried one, then another-and then the red lightsaber spun out of his hands".
- MasterCilghal recalls Dark Lord: Rise of Darth Vader: the Sith "have gone beyond the use of lightsabers" (cf. plagueis-comicvine-respect.txt: "The Sith grew past the use of lightsabers").
- **Verdicts (opinion):** Yoda wins a pure duel: Azronger, Ziggy, DC77 ("beat him fair and square"), HellfireUnit ("by a small margin"), CuckedCurry, DoA, MP ("Yoda is more skilled"). Almost nobody argues Sidious in pure sabers. Azronger (t313) later: "Yoda had an inherent stylistic advantage and capitalized on it with a sudden burst of speed. They're equals in raw skill."

## 3. t313 "ROTS | Sidious vs Windu Discussion" (77 posts, Jun 2019–Jul 2020)
URL: https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t313-rots-sidious-vs-windu-discussion
- **Threw the fight?** O-Siri: the disarm came from "the shadow's fear", but "Do you think the fear you feel is mine?" / "And Palpatine was not afraid." (ROTS novel). So why hesitate? Maybe a last-minute improvisation. MP: the shatterpoint was Anakin. Mace later senses "Palpatine trusts Anakin Skywalker..." (ROTS novel).
- **Mace legit matched him** (PeraltaEagle45): the novel has a perfect stalemate; "The fighting was effortless for him now"; the film puts Anakin's arrival after the disarm. Cited (no scans): *New Essential Chronology*, Sidious unleashed "his full fury" on Fisto, Kolar, Tiin; *Lightsabers: A Guide to the Weapons of the Force*, a "concentrated Dark Side confusion haze" used on the B-team, implying it didn't affect Mace.
- **Counter** (MP): "This was beyond Vaapad; he had no strength left to fight against his own blade." (ROTS novel). Sidious Force-pushes Mace into a wall in the script and comic.
- **Sidious toyed / set it up** (Azronger *scan* from the *Vehicles Collection* [issue not given], "There he seemed to gain the upper hand. Palpatine attempted to use Force lightning to strike down Master Windu, but it backfired." PeraltaEagle45: that wording still shows lethal intent).
- SnowxElf's typed quote: the impasse passage ("not even the possibility of fatigue"). Argues the lightning went "beyond Vaapad", so Mace was spending his own reserves, and Palpatine "was never exhausted".
- **Verdicts (opinion):** Sidious > Mace overall: MP, LOTL ("Mace being amped vastly has been pretty much debunked"), Bart ("Palpatine wins 8/10"), MacialRecognition, SnowxElf, Caelus Pall, TheNuisanceBird, BigMouthPrick. Mace legit matched or won the saber portion: PeraltaEagle45, BreakofDawn ("Mace was slightly better as a swordsman... Sheev was more powerful"), O-Siri (film), Caelus Pall ("genuinely disarm"). Near consensus: **Mace = Sidious in sabers while Vaapad-amped; Sidious > Mace in the Force.**

## 4. Smaller threads
- **t3544 Sidious vs Yoda & Windu (ROTS):** mostly the duo (TenebrousWay, S_W_LeGenD, DarthAnt66 "Duo stomps", BreakofDawn "either Mace or Yoda can stalemate Sidious... for a considerable amount of time", HellfireUnit, SnowxElf). Azronger and Grey say Sidious can win with lightning spam ("Palpatine's unparalleled mastery to exploit openings and presumably disproportionate affinity towards Force lightning"). SnowxElf: "Mace's Vaapad is pretty scenario oriented", so he might not get the office amp here. (Opinion.)
- **t3555 RotJ Yoda runs the Mace gauntlet:** most say a dying RotJ Yoda loses early. *Beware the Power of the Dark Side!* quote (typed): "Already he has used the Force to prolong his life beyond what is natural... His small body has long ago worn out." Useful only as an era cap: OT Yoda ≠ PT Yoda.
- **t1385 six-way saber FFA (Yoda/Sidious/Mace/Luke/KFV/Dooku):** Meatpants: Luke > Yoda > Mace > Sidious. dark_globe: "yoda is the best duelist there ever was". One poster: "Yoda = Sheev = Mace in skill". The Ellimist: Luke, Dooku, KFV, Yoda, Mace, Sidious, all close. (Opinion; no sources quoted.)
- **t3667 unarmed Sidious vs Yoda:** split. Labyrinth of Evil quote typed: "Sidious and Yoda had certain qualities in common... that neither was entirely what he appeared to be - that is, made frail by age". Sidious "master of numerous exotic and forbidden martial arts" (Azronger; source not named). Fun thread, not used for verdicts.
- **t2186 TPM Sidious + Plagueis vs TPM Yoda + Mace:** the Sith win (opinion). The ILS/NotAA3 side-debate: TPM-era "Mace ≈ Yoda" accolades are "out of date". Supports discounting TPM-era Mace = Yoda lines.
- **t3251 RotS Sidious vs TPM Mace:** unanimous Sidious. O-Siri: "TPM Mace hasn't conquered his fear of his inner darkness which enabled him to fight without his Jedi restraint and match Sidious."

## My read of the forum material (not a verdict; see verdicts.md)
- The forums mostly agree: Yoda ≥ Sidious in sabers; Sidious ≥ Yoda overall because of lightning, reserves and the result; Mace = Sidious in sabers only with the Vaapad amp, < Sidious in the Force.
- The strongest pro-Yoda point that rests on primary sources: the JN and script show Yoda driving Sidious back on neutral ground (the office) and disarming him. The strongest pro-Sidious point: every version ends with Yoda the one who can't continue, and Stover frames Yoda as at "the limits of his strength". Only Sidious's lightning answers Yoda's saber edge, and Yoda can't answer it in kind.
- Not verified this pass: the Insider #86, Vehicles Collection, Movie Storybook and 100 Scenes scans (typed text only, no images checked).

## ADDED 2026-10-19: SI t1259 Mace Windu vs Darth Plagueis (71 posts, 3 pages). https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t1259-mace-windu-vs-darth-plagueis  raw: forum-raw/sw1019/t1259*. OPINION ONLY.
- Rounds (KingofBlades OP): 1 sabers, 2 Force, 3 all-out.
- Near-unanimous: Mace wins sabers (HellfireUnit "if Vaapad is functional", Bart "not a shadow of doubt", xolthol, Shioz, Azronger, BreakofDawn "He gets stomped in sabers").
- Force round mostly Plagueis (HellfireUnit "in a stomp", Ziggy, Bart: "Mace has greater raw power maybe, but Plagueis dwarves him in versatility, mastery", Shioz, xolthol, Azronger, NevesYtneves).
- All-out split: Plagueis (HellfireUnit, Azronger "He's arguably just as if not more powerful than Windu, and he's far more masterful and has more hax", MP, CuckedCurry "Mace is a really serious threat especially if Plagueis goes the scenic route", Corvinus "he can take himself out of his body and puppet it like a marionette as per his duel with Venamis"), Mace (darthbane77 "Comparability/nigh-parity to RotS Sidious puts him outside Plagueis' ability to defeat in a straight fight", BreakofDawn "a peer of ROTS Sheev", NevesYtneves, xolthol, O-Siri, Latham2000), toss-up (dark_globe, Shioz).
- Key evidence posted: midi-chlorian manipulation (Book of Sith entry and Darth Plagueis novel: "death is fixed in space and time" passage, The Lost; slayne/Azronger: inducing midi-chlorian death is easier than healing); KingofBlades: "I still fail to see any evidence that Plagueis would be able to perform MM offensively to any meaningful extent against a powerful force user"; slayne: Plagueis "face-tanking Sidious' lightning" (Darth Plagueis novel, the death scene; Reynard/Ethanion disputes the reading); ROTS novel: "This was beyond Vaapad; he had no strength" (HellfireUnit) vs "Despite being exhausted and Vaapad being virtually useless he still held off Sheev's lightning for a good amount of time" (BreakofDawn); CuckedCurry: "Mace is below Dooku in raw tk output, nevermind Plagueis. BOD just hasn't read Shatterpoint".
